    ## Reason for This Test
    The downstream deployment must carry a reactive event trigger that runs it automatically when the upstream deployment's flow run reaches the Completed state (not a schedule).

    ## Verification Steps

Open the downstream deployment 'downstream-deploy-zrwydi2yve' (check its details/Triggers section) and/or the Automations page at http://127.0.0.1:4200/automations. Confirm it is an event-reactive trigger and NOT a time-based schedule.

    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
